description: Collapsed wing of a regional hospital. Medical supplies may remain in sealed rooms.
A stripped roadside station. Fuel drums and scrap metal scattered across the lot.
Intact house in a low-density neighborhood. Pantry, tools, maybe a working stove.
Sealed military installation. High-value supplies behind heavy doors.
A sealed pre-war storage locker in a collapsed residential block. Coordinates from a stranger. Real or a trap — you won't know until you're there.
Unstable ground, boiling toxic mud. The pipes still hiss with underground steam. High chance of geothermal salvage.
Sealed blast doors. Starving, inbred elite descendants guard pre-war luxuries with improvised weapons.
Stuck in the ice. Guarded by cannibalistic dockworkers who have been surviving on frozen cargo for years.
Derailed military train. A cracked RTG creates a localized radiation hotspot visible from kilometers away.
High altitude. -60C ambient. The air is so clear you can see the curvature of the ash-choked earth.
Heavily trapped, frozen solid. Designed to survive a century underground. The seeds inside are the last unmutated crops.
Propaganda servers still humming on backup power. The truth about Protocol Zero is buried in encrypted data-drives.
A massive dumping ground for frozen corpses. The ash preserves them perfectly. Disease risk is extreme.
Cable cars frozen mid-swing. Luxury items preserved in sub-zero temperatures. The wealthy died warm in their furs.
Deep drilling equipment surrounded by toxic groundwater. The borehole goes down 3 kilometers into the earth's crust.
Pitch black, waist-deep toxic water. Requires waders. The Sump-Dredgers navigate by echolocation. Pre-war transit tech buried in the silt.
Sealed elite transit tunnels. Overgrown with bioluminescent Ash-Blight. The walls breathe. Pneumatic jacks and encrypted drives in the maintenance bays.
High methane risk. Requires rebreather. The pipes groan with pressurised sludge. Chemicals, fertiliser, and scrap metal in the settling tanks.
Massive caverns, high cave-in risk. Salt is vital for food preservation. Shoring timber scattered among the collapsed support beams.
Ground Zero for the Myco-Protocol. Lethal spore density. The fungus learned to eat people here. Fungicide formula and military hazmat suits in sealed lockers.
Flooded server farm. Requires improvised scuba gear. Watertight server blades and solar cells in the raised floor plenum.
Boiling mud, toxic sulfur gas. The earth's mantle bleeds heat through fractured rock. Geothermal valves and thermal paste in the control room.
An underground cistern turned shrine by the Dredgers. Bioluminescent moss covers every surface. They trade pure water for UV lamps and iodine.
Rusted RO membranes and cracked high-pressure hoses. The Hydro-Barons' former stronghold. Reverse osmosis salvage for the desperate.
Endgame location. A 2-mile deep shaft tapping the mantle. The mantle tap valve inside could unlock infinite geothermal power — if you survive the descent.
A six-lane highway paved entirely with unexploded cluster bombs. Every step is a gamble. Mine prodders and tactical scrap in the median strip.
Massive, groaning metal dish. High magnetic anomaly that rips compasses from your pocket. Vacuum tubes and copper wire in the control shack.
An open missile silo repurposed as a nesting ground for loitering munitions. They buzz like hornets. Car batteries and explosive powder in the launch bay.
A bunker firing blindly into the ash-wastes on a 12-hour timer. The Custodian does not sleep. Mortar shells and gunpowder in the magazine.
A camp built inside the chassis of a downed cargo plane. The Wire-Heads worship logic gates and sell bypass codes. Faraday mesh and circuit boards for trade.
A localised magnetic storm that rips metal from your hands. Compasses spin, dosimeters lie. Tungsten bars and RTG batteries in the impact core.
Rusted transport trucks in rows. Guarded by a single, glitching sentry gun that tracks movement but cannot lead targets. Engine blocks and fuel jerrycans.
Anechoic chambers. Dead silence so complete you can hear your own blood. High psychological stress. Sound baffling and military headphones in the test rigs.
A massive electrical transformer yard. High EMP risk from arcing capacitors. Generator alternators and electrical cable in the switching house.
Endgame location. The regional server controlling the UXO fields. The Custodian's last outpost. The master override key inside silences the machines — forever.
The hidden sub-level where the amnestics were synthesized. Loot: item_scopolamine_root, item_lithium_salts.
High altitude, zero ash cover. Lethal UV Scourge. Loot: item_welders_glass, item_mirror_shard.
Pre-war elite bunker. They starved in velvet. Loot: item_vinyl_collection, item_gold_bars, item_epoxy_resin.
Industrial ruin. High structural collapse risk. Loot: item_galvanized_rebar, item_cement_mix.
The outer doors failed; the inner doors held. Loot: item_seed_ledger, item_non_irradiated_wheat.
Echoes of the early panic. High psychological stress. Loot: item_opioid_painkillers, item_straitjacket_canvas.
Shattered glass everywhere. Requires item_work_boots. Loot: item_mirror_shard, item_silver_nitrate.
Massive, groaning dishes pointing at a dead sky. Loot: item_vacuum_tube, item_copper_wire_10m.
The fossilized remains of a massive, pre-war subterranean root network. Loot: item_bio_plastic, item_fertilizer.
Endgame. A server farm dedicated to backing up civilian social media. Loot: item_hard_drive_platter.
